portalTint.purpose: Soft tint behind the current portal tab's icon and the current portal rail row; never text, icon colour or edge.

headline.purpose: Admin page titles: the Home greeting and every page header. Portal screens title at 20px/600 instead.

figure.purpose: Money amounts in the money strip; in the portal the lesson card's time range, the tutor's earnings and the affiliate's figures. Tabular figures.

title.purpose: Panel headings and the settings area heading; in the portal (16px reading base) a row's primary line, such as the lesson title and the owed line.

body.purpose: The working size: tables, lists, navigation, buttons, subtitles.

caption.purpose: One muted context line under a row, field hints, chart axis labels, table column headings (at 600), the portal tab bar's labels.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked: navigation group headings (admin rail, settings sub-menu, portal rail and More sheet) and the NOW rule only.

shadows.name: floating-menu
shadows.purpose: The account menu (admin and portal) and other elements that float over the page; the only shadow. The portal's modal More sheet has none.

shadows.name: current-margin-rule
shadows.purpose: 1px red rule inside the current admin rail item's left edge (not depth). The portal rail uses the brand tint instead.

focus.name: focus-ring
focus.purpose: Global :focus-visible outline in link ink, never the tenant colour, so focus stays AA however pale the tenant's brand; inside the rail it uses shell-foreground instead.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover fills, opacity and the group chevron rotation.

motion.name: skeleton-pulse
motion.purpose: Loading placeholders (wash bars and data-grid skeleton rows).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Applied to everything under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

motion.name: sheet-slide
motion.purpose: The portal's More sheet sliding up from the tab bar on opening.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Register tables show the tutor column; portal lesson-card actions leave their two phone columns for one wrapping row; Copy link moves beside its value.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Admin: the rail is shown (below it, a modal drawer). Portal: the 240px rail replaces the tab bar.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Home gains its 22rem attention column; settings sub-menu becomes a sticky side column.

globalDefaults.name: field-edge
globalDefaults.purpose: Unlayered, so every text input, select and textarea (shared or hand-styled) meets the Field Edge rule; [aria-invalid=true] keeps the danger edge.

globalDefaults.name: table-ruling
globalDefaults.selector: table / thead th / tbody tr + tr
globalDefaults.value: border-collapse: collapse; th: left, 12px, 600, muted-foreground; rows: 1px solid hsl(var(--tt-rule))
globalDefaults.purpose: Base-layer defaults so hand-built tables read as register tables; utilities can override.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Register"**

TutorTrack's admin app is drawn from the teacher's register and mark book, because marking a lesson is what bills it and pays for it. The navigation is the bookcloth cover: a deep green rail with the organisation's name at the top and modules grouped by job. The work area is the register's stock: a near-white ground ruled in pale blue, written in blue-black ink. One red margin rule is the only loud colour, and it means one thing: now, or something that still needs marking or is overdue. Lesson state is shown with authored register marks (a tick, a ring, a struck ring, a dashed ring), never with generic status badges.

The system is dense and desk-oriented: one family in five sizes, 14px body text, tabular figures wherever numbers are compared, and 1px rules instead of shadows or tinted cards. Depth comes from rules and the shell/stock contrast, not elevation. The tenant's brand colour reaches primary-button fills, the caret, text selection and, in the portal, a soft tint behind the current navigation item only; the ink (including the focus ring), the rules, the shell and the margin red stay constant so contrast holds in both colour schemes and under any tenant colour.

The portal (families, students, tutors and partners) is the same register carried in a pocket, and it is white-labelled: it has no bookcloth cover. Its navigation is a clean leaf (a tab bar under the thumb on phones, a rail on wider screens) with the tenant's logo or name in ink. The tenant colour appears on primary fills and as a soft tint behind the current tab or row, never as text.

Scope of this record: it is evidenced by stages 1 to 4 of the build. Stage 1: the shared tokens and font in `packages/ui/src/styles.css`, the register marks, the admin shell and Home. Stage 2: the shared components in `packages/ui` (page header, button styles for links, fields, alerts, tabs, the data grid, chart labels), global defaults for form-control edges and hand-built tables, and the people list screens (Clients, Students, Tutors). Stage 3: the admin calendar (toolbar, day/week/tutor/room time grids, month and agenda). Stage 4: the portal's shared frame (`apps/portal/src/layout/PortalFrame.tsx`: header, tab bar, More sheet, rail, account menu) for every role, sign-in, the lesson card, and each role's home screen (family Home, tutor Today, affiliate Overview). The other admin modules' screens and the portal's inner screens (Schedule, Billing, Messages, Classes, Privacy and the rest) sit inside their converted shells but have not themselves been carried into this world, beyond what they inherit from the shared components and global defaults. The reporting dashboard below Home is ruled off from Home's work area and no longer repeats Home's figures, but its widgets and heading still predate the world. Treat those surfaces as unconverted, not as examples.
keyCharacteristics: Bookcloth-green navigation rail on a ruled, near-white register stock (dark scheme: night-green rail on a blue-slate stock).
Blue-black ink for text; register-blue rules (1px) for every divider, table row and panel edge.
One red margin rule for now, needs-marking, overdue and waiting counts; nothing else is red except errors.
Source Sans 3 (self-hosted variable font) is the only family, in five fixed sizes, with tabular figures in tables, inputs, times and money.
Authored SVG register marks for lesson state, the same five marks everywhere.
Flat: panels are ruled, not raised. The only shadow is on floating menus.
The portal is white-labelled: a clean-leaf header and tab bar (rail on wide screens), the business name in ink, the tenant colour only on primary fills and as a soft tint behind the current item.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Margin red means now, overdue, or still to mark, plus the count of waiting items. It is never decoration, never a brand colour and never an error colour.

rules.name: The Tenant Fills, the Register Inks Rule
rules.body: A tenant's colour replaces `brand` (primary-button fills, caret, selection, and the portal's soft tint behind the current item) and nothing else. Links and the focus outline use `link`, which tenants never change; text, rules, shell and margin red are fixed. The business name in the portal header is ink, not brand.

rules.name: The Soft Tint Rule
rules.body: In the portal, where you are is shown by the tenant colour as a soft tint behind the current item: brand at 15% in a pill behind the current tab's icon, brand at 10% behind the current rail row. The label beside it is ink at 600. The tint is never text, an icon colour, an underline or an edge.

rules.name: The Field Edge Rule
rules.body: A form control's boundary uses `field` (3:1 or better in both schemes); a global rule applies it to every text input, select and textarea, and invalid controls turn `danger`. `border` and `rule` are for dividers, panels and secondary-button edges only.

rules.name: The Bookcloth Rule
rules.body: Shell green is the admin navigation's cover: rail, drawer, avatar. Work areas never sit on it. Lines on the cover use `shell-rule`, never a white overlay. The white-labelled portal has no cover: its navigation is a clean leaf ruled off with `border`.

rules.name: The Five Sizes Rule
rules.body: 12, 14, 16, 20 and 26px carry the whole hierarchy, charts included. A new screen picks from these; it does not add a size.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Tables, inputs, `<time>` elements and money amounts use tabular figures so columns of numbers line up.

rules.name: The Label Is Navigation Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked labels name navigation groups and mark the NOW rule. They never sit above a page or panel heading as a kicker.

rules.name: The One Work Area Rule
rules.body: Each screen has one leading work area; side columns stay narrower and subordinate (Home: register first, attention lists at 22rem).

rules.name: The Say It Once Rule
rules.body: A figure appears once per screen. Secondary areas below the work area leave out what the work area already shows.

rules.name: The Fixed Columns Rule
rules.body: Register tables keep a fixed column order and fixed widths for the time (96px) and mark (80px) columns; values update in place. On phones a secondary column (tutor) folds into the row's context lines rather than reflowing the table.

rules.name: The One Landmark Rule
rules.body: The portal shows one navigation landmark at a time: the tab bar on phones, the rail from 768px. The two are never both in the page.

rules.name: The Ruled, Not Raised Rule
rules.body: Panels, strips and lists are separated by 1px rules. Shadows are reserved for elements that float over the page.

dos: **Do** use the semantic tokens (`brand`, `link`, `foreground`, `rule`, `field`, `margin`, …) through Tailwind's colour names; never write raw colours in components.
**Do** keep text links and focus outlines on `link`, so they stay AA whatever colour the tenant chooses.
**Do** draw form-control boundaries with `field` (3:1 or better in both schemes); the global rule already covers inputs, selects and textareas, so don't override it with `border`.
**Do** show lesson state with `RegisterMark` and an accessible label, the same five marks on every screen.
**Do** separate content with 1px register or row rules; keep panels flat.
**Do** express comparisons in words beside the figure ("£120 more than last month").
**Do** give every row one primary line and at most one caption context line.
**Do** collapse navigation groups when more than 16 items are visible, and show waiting counts on closed groups.
**Do** use tabular figures for times, tables and money, and pick sizes only from 12, 14, 16, 20 and 26px.
**Do** open a page with the shared page header, secondary actions small and the primary last.
**Do** put list filters in one compact row with self-describing first options, above a data grid.
**Do** style links that act as buttons with the shared button styles.
**Do** check every new pair in both schemes; the dark scheme has its own values for every token.
**Do** build portal screens inside `PortalFrame`: up to four everyday tabs plus More on phones, the rail from 768px, one navigation landmark at a time, sign out in the account menu.
**Do** mark the current portal tab or rail row with the soft brand tint (15% behind the tab's icon, 10% behind the rail row) and the label in ink at 600.
**Do** order a lesson's actions by use: Join first and full width, Cancel lesson last as a faded-ink ghost.
donts: **Don't** use margin red for decoration, branding or errors; errors use `danger`.
**Don't** let the tenant colour reach link text, the focus outline, rules, the shell or the margin red.
**Don't** build KPI tiles, sparklines or stat cards; money reads as one ruled strip.
**Don't** put a coloured side border thicker than 1px on any card, row or nav item.
**Don't** use unicode glyphs or generic status badges for lesson state.
**Don't** add drop shadows to panels or cards; only floating menus cast one.
**Don't** add a second typeface or a display size above 26px.
**Don't** use uppercase tracked labels as kickers above headings.
**Don't** show the flat list of every module; navigation stays grouped by job and permission-gated.
**Don't** use raw palette colours (amber, white overlays) for status tints or rail lines; use `warning`, `danger`, `success` and `shell-rule`.
**Don't** repeat a figure the screen already shows in a second widget or tile.
**Don't** set text, icons or edges in the tenant colour in the portal; the business name is ink and the current item is a tint, not brand-coloured text.
**Don't** use bookcloth green in the portal, or wrap the portal's destinations into a cloud of links; the rest go under More, grouped by job.
